name: Regular Show
description: The surreal misadventures of two best friends - a blue jay and a raccoon - as they seek to liven up their mundane jobs as groundskeepers at the local park.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Mordecai and Rigby have started their new job, and are pretty pleased with their lodgings. The only cloud on the horizon is the fact they have no furniture. Luckily, Pops is throwing out a chair he doesn't find comfortable, so the two decide to settle ownership with a game of Rock Paper Scissors.

videos.title: Ringtoneers
videos.overview: Mordecai and Rigby want to prove that they can make a really cool ringtone.

videos.title: Party Tonight - Regular Show 1 Million Fan Exclusive
videos.overview: OOOOOOOHHHHHHH!!! Regular Show's creator JG Quintel and Cartoon Network love all 1 Million of you so much, we had Mordecai, Rigby, and the rest of the park guys make this Party Tonight music video that's so awesome, it can only be described with three letters: R-A-D. You can only see it here, so thanks for being a Regular Show fan!!

videos.title: Party Tonight - TV Version
videos.overview: A live action music video by the Regular Show Gang served as a "thank you" for 1 million Facebook likes. This short made its first appearance on Cartoon Network on April 17, 2012.

videos.title: The Naive Man from Lolliland
videos.overview: Quintel's 1st student film, "The Naive Man from Lolliland" tells the story of a foreign ambassador who visits the United States only to learn that his customs are unwelcome. Features an early inspiration for Pops.

videos.title: 2 in the AM PM
videos.overview: Quintel's 2nd student film, "2 in the AM PM" tells the story of two slackers, who are left alone to run a convenience store on Halloween night, where candy filled with drugs creates a mini-nightmare. Features early inspirations for Mordecai and Benson.

videos.title: Four Things You Didn't Know About J.G.
videos.overview: Included as a special feature on the Season 3 DVD

videos.title: J.G. Answers Why
videos.overview: Included as a special feature on the Season 3 DVD

videos.title: Characters Come to Life: Live Episode Read
videos.overview: Included as a special feature on the Season 3 DVD

videos.overview: Mordecai and Rigby try and prank the Master Prank Caller to be the best prank callers, but he sends them back to 1982.

videos.overview: Rigby's estranged accountant brother comes back to help save the park from an audit. While everyone loves Don, Rigby wants nothing to do with him.

videos.title: Ello Gov'nor

videos.overview: Benson buys a surveillance system to track Mordecai and Rigby's every move when their constant slacking pushes him to the breaking point.

videos.overview: When Maellard asks Pops, his son, to give a speech, Mordecai and Rigby try to help him overcome his stage fright.

videos.title: High Score

videos.overview: Mordecai and Rigby expose a bad board game's flaws when the owner refuses to give them a refund.

videos.title: This is My Jam
videos.overview: Rigby gets a terrible, terrible song stuck in his head and will go to any lengths to get it out.

videos.title: Muscle Woman

videos.title: Jinx

videos.title: See You There

videos.overview: Mordecai and Rigby plan to host a scary-movie night at the abandoned cemetery in the park so they can raise enough funds to earn a paid-day off.

videos.overview: Skips accidentally kills Rigby while arm wrestling and fights Death to get him back.

videos.title: A Bunch of Baby Ducks
videos.overview: Mordecai and Rigby come across a family of ducks living in a fountain at the park - and take quite a shine to them.

videos.title: More Smarter
videos.overview: Mordecai begins to make fun of Rigby for not having a high school diploma so Rigby decides to drink a chemical that is supposed to make him smarter.

videos.title: Go Viral
